text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! This sensation of light bursting 
forth— What is this...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Could it really be... the Three 
Goddesses...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much. For granting me 
new possibilities♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I will never let this light go to waste. I 
shall shine even brighter for you!
